evidence: The Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index sits at 74 ('Greed'), unchanged from the previous day and up significantly from its 30-day average of 44.4. A sharp multi-day ascent from extreme fear territory (25 on July 13) to elevated greed indicates robust bullish sentiment and upward price momentum. However, high greed scores can also indicate overbought conditions susceptible to short-term consolidation or mean reversion over a 24-hour horizon. Consequently, the probability of an upward move over the next 24 hours is assessed with a moderate positive bias at 0.54 rather than tracking the raw score.
limitations: Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
